title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn, Feb 13, 2027
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra presents An American Hymn, an evening of orchestral and choral works by American composers that invite reflection on the sacred and holy. The program includes Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, Copland's Appalachian Spring, built around the Shaker hymn Simple Gifts, and Jessie Montgomery's Starburst. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
